Staff evaluates requirements and conducts site inspection (30 min + 1 hour).
Staff computes assessment fee and endorses to Zoning Officer & BFP (15 min + 15 min).
Pay fees at Treasury Office. Zoning officer & Fire Dept conduct inspection (10 min).
Receive Zoning/Locational & Fire Safety clearance (15 min).
Receive the Electrical Permit (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Get an electrical permit from the Mapandan Municipal Engineer. Required for all electrical installations and wiring.

services.name: Birth Registration
services.description: Registration of birth with the Municipal Civil Registrar. Covers registration by attending midwife/hilot, unmarried parents, hospital administrators, and late registration with PSA verification.
services.description_full: Registration of birth at the Municipal Civil Registrar. Covers three pathways: (1) Attending midwife/hilot reports child's birth — requires Marriage Certificate of parents and Mun. Form 102; (2) Unmarried parents — requires Community Tax Certificate; (3) Hospital administrator — requires Accomplished Mun. Form 102. Late registration requires negative PSA certification and supporting documents. Fees: Misc Fee ₱115 (standard), ₱215 (unmarried), ₱100 (hospital), ₱315–₱1,015 (late registration depending on age).
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Marriage Certificate of parents from PSA (for attending midwife/hilot registration)
Community Tax Certificate from Treasury Office (for unmarried parents)
Accomplished Mun. Form 102 from MCR (for hospital registration)
Negative certification from PSA (for late registration)
Affidavit of delayed registration (for late registration)
Supporting evidence: Baptismal Certificate, School records, ITR, Insurance Policy, Medical records, Barangay certification (for late registration)
procedure: Attending midwife/hilot reports child's birth. MCR evaluates information and registers (10 min).
For unmarried parents: Hospital admin or representative prepares documents (15 min).
For late registration: Apply at MCR, verify from CRIS/Registry Book. If negative, submit requirements. Data typed in Certificate of Live Birth (15 min typing).
MCR approves registration (after 10 days of posting for late registration).
Secure copy of birth certificate. MCR releases documents (3 min).
services.hero_lede: Register a birth at the Mapandan MCR. Standard fee ₱115, late registration ₱315–₱1,015.

services.name: Death Registration
services.description: Registration of death with the Municipal Civil Registrar. Covers registration by solemnizing officer, hospital administrator, or nearest relative. Late registration available with PSA verification.
services.description_full: Registration of death at the Municipal Civil Registrar. The solemnizing officer or authorized representative submits the Certificate of Marriage for verification. If the place of death is not in a hospital, the person who last attended the deceased reports. Late registration requires negative PSA certification. Fee for late registration: ₱215. MCR approves after 10 days of posting.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Accomplished Certificate of Marriage
Negative certification from PSA (for late registration)
Affidavit of delayed registration (for late registration)
Certified copy of Marriage license (for late registration)
procedure: Solemnizing Officer or authorized representative submits documents. MCR examines accuracy and completeness (10 min).
In default of Solemnizing Officer, either or both contracting parties may report (10 min).
For late registration: Verify from CRIS/Registry Book. If negative, submit requirements and prepare certificate (20 min, ₱215).
MCR approves documents (after 10 days of posting).
Secure copy of death certificate or late registration. Release documents (3 min).
services.hero_lede: Register a death at the Mapandan MCR. Late registration fee ₱215.

services.name: Marriage License Registration
services.description: Registration and issuance of marriage license at the Municipal Civil Registrar. Includes interview, fee payment, and document release. Fee: ₱862.
services.description_full: Registration and issuance of marriage license at the Municipal Civil Registrar. The MCR interviews the parties on their residence, verifies birth certificates, and processes the application. The client proceeds to Treasury for payment (₱862) and returns to MCR for document release. Additional requirements for delayed registration include negative PSA certification.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Municipal Form No. 90
Community Tax Certificate (from Treasury Office)
Parental Consent of father/guardian (from MCR)
Certificate of Family Planning (from Mun Health Office)
Certificate of Pre-Marriage Counselling (from MSWD Office)
CENOMAR / Birth Certificate (from PSA)
Legal Capacity (from DFA, if one party is a foreigner)
procedure: Apply for marriage license at MCR. Interview conducted on residence, birth certificates verified.
Proceed to Treasury Office for payment of ₱862.
Receive official receipt.
Present OR to MCR Office. Staff advises on issuance of license.
Secure copy of marriage license. Documents released.
services.hero_lede: Apply for a marriage license at the Mapandan MCR. Fee: ₱862.

services.name: Birth / Marriage / Death Certifications
services.description: Issuance of certified copies of birth, marriage, death, and other civil registry documents. Fee: ₱115 per copy. PSA endorsement available for ₱200.
services.description_full: Issuance of certified copies of birth, marriage, death, and other civil registry documents from the Municipal Civil Registrar. The MCR verifies records through CRIS/Registry Book and prepares the certificate. Fee: ₱115 per copy. For PSA endorsement: additional ₱200. Various MCR forms are available depending on document availability and status.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: MCR Form 1A (Birth authorization) / 1B (Birth not available) / 1C (Birth destroyed)
MCR Form 3A (Marriage) / 3B (Marriage not available) / 3C (Marriage destroyed)
MCR Form 2A (Death not available) / 3C (Death destroyed)
procedure: Request certification from MCR. Staff verifies through CRIS/Registry Book and prepares certificate (15 min).
MCR certifies the facts stated as to correctness.
Proceed to Treasury Office for payment of ₱115 per copy.
Present OR to MCR Office. Documents released.
For PSA endorsement: MCR verifies and prepares endorsement (₱200, 10 min).
services.hero_lede: Get certified copies of birth, marriage, or death certificates at the Mapandan MCR. ₱115 per copy.

services.name: Legal Document Registration
services.description: Registration of legal documents including Affidavit of Legitimation, Affidavit of Acknowledgement, and RA 9255 (use of father's surname). Fee: ₱215–₱315.
services.description_full: Registration of legal documents at the Municipal Civil Registrar. Covers Affidavit of Legitimation (for parents not married before child's birth), Affidavit of Acknowledgement (for fathers acknowledging children), and RA 9255 applications (use of father's surname). Fee: ₱315 for legitimation, ₱215 for acknowledgement and RA 9255. MCR examines documents, prepares attachments, and makes annotations on the registry book.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Affidavit of Legitimation (for legitimation)
CENOMAR from PSA
Certified copy of child's COLB from MCR
Certified copy of parent's Marriage Certificate from MCR
Affidavit of Acknowledgement (for acknowledgement)
Affidavit to use the surname of the father (for RA 9255)
Other supporting documents: baptismal certificate, insurance policies
procedure: For legitimation: Parents not married before child's birth submit requirements. MCR examines documents, prepares attachments, and annotates registry book (₱315, 20–25 min).
For acknowledgement: Father acknowledges children. Same procedure as above (₱215, 20–25 min).
For RA 9255: Parents apply to use father's surname. Same procedure (₱215, 20–25 min).
MCR annotates and approves documents (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Register legal documents at the Mapandan MCR. Legitimation, acknowledgement, and RA 9255 services available.

services.name: Court Order Annotation & Adoption
services.description: Annotation of COLB/COD based on court order for corrections, annulment, or presumptive death. Also covers issuance of amended COLB for adoption. Fee: ₱515.
services.description_full: Annotation of Certificate of Live Birth (COLB) or Certificate of Death (COD) based on court order. Covers corrections of entries, annulment, presumptive death, and adoption. The MCR examines documents for authenticity and completeness, makes annotations on the certificate, and prepares other attachments. For adoption, an amended COLB is prepared. Fee: ₱515 for both services.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Certified copy of Court petition from PSA
Court Order from PSA
Finality and certification of registration where the court is functioning from PSA
procedure: Present court order for correction of entries / annulment / presumptive death. MCR examines documents (30 min, ₱515).
MCR makes annotations on the certificate and prepares attachments (15 min).
For adoption: Present court order. MCR examines documents and prepares amended COLB (20 min, ₱515).
services.hero_lede: Annotate civil registry documents based on court order at the Mapandan MCR. ₱515 for corrections and adoption.

services.name: Mayor's Clearance & Certificates
services.description: The Office of the Mayor issues various clearances and certificates to residents and businesses of Mapandan. This includes residency clearance, business endorsement, and other official certifications signed by the Mayor.
services.description_full: The Office of the Mayor issues various clearances and certificates to residents and businesses of Mapandan. The staff receives the request, verifies the applicant's records, prepares the document, and submits it to the Mayor for signature. The client pays the required fee at the Treasury Office before claiming the document.
services.where_to_apply: Office of the Municipal Mayor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Letter of Request
Valid Government-issued ID
Community Tax Certificate (Cedula) from Treasury Office
procedure: Submit letter of request and valid ID to the Mayor's Office.
Staff receives and reviews the request (5 min).
Pay ₱130 at the Treasury Office and obtain official receipt.
Present OR to the Mayor's Office. Staff prepares the document for the Mayor's signature (5 min).
Receive the signed clearance or certificate (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Get a clearance or certificate signed by the Mayor of Mapandan. ₱130 fee, 15 minutes processing.

services.name: Subscription of Affidavits
services.description: The Office of the Mayor administers the subscription of affidavits for residents of Mapandan. The Mayor or authorized representative administers the oath and signs the affidavit.
services.description_full: The Office of the Mayor administers the subscription of affidavits for residents of Mapandan. The client presents the draft affidavit, the Mayor or authorized representative administers the oath, and the document is signed and sealed. The client pays the required fee at the Treasury Office.
services.where_to_apply: Office of the Municipal Mayor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Draft Affidavit (printed in legal size bond paper)
Valid Government-issued ID of the affiant
Community Tax Certificate (Cedula) from Treasury Office
procedure: Present the draft affidavit and valid ID to the Mayor's Office.
Staff reviews the document (5 min).
Pay ₱130 at the Treasury Office and obtain official receipt.
Present OR. The Mayor or authorized representative administers the oath and signs the affidavit (5 min).
Receive the notarized affidavit (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Have your affidavit subscribed and sworn before the Mayor of Mapandan. ₱130 fee, 15 minutes processing.

services.name: Solemnization of Marriage
services.description: The Municipal Mayor of Mapandan is authorized to solemnize marriages. Couples with a valid marriage license may request the Mayor to officiate their wedding ceremony at the Mayor's Office or an agreed venue.
services.description_full: The Municipal Mayor of Mapandan is authorized to solemnize marriages under the Family Code of the Philippines. Couples must first obtain a marriage license from the Municipal Civil Registrar. The Mayor's Office schedules the ceremony and the Mayor administers the marriage rites. A Certificate of Marriage is prepared and signed by the Mayor, the couple, and witnesses.
services.where_to_apply: Office of the Municipal Mayor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Valid Marriage License (from Municipal Civil Registrar)
Valid Government-issued IDs of both parties
Two (2) witnesses with valid IDs
procedure: Present the Marriage License and valid IDs to the Mayor's Office.
Staff schedules the solemnization date and time.
Appear on the scheduled date with two (2) witnesses.
The Mayor administers the marriage rites and signs the Certificate of Marriage.
Receive the signed Certificate of Marriage.
services.hero_lede: Have your marriage solemnized by the Mayor of Mapandan. Free service for couples with a valid marriage license.

services.name: Mayor's Employment Recommendation
services.description: The Office of the Mayor issues recommendation letters for residents seeking employment, scholarship, or other opportunities. The letter certifies the applicant's good moral character and residency in Mapandan.
services.description_full: The Office of the Mayor issues recommendation letters for residents of Mapandan who are applying for employment, scholarship, or other opportunities requiring a character reference from the Local Chief Executive. The staff reviews the application, prepares the recommendation letter, and submits it to the Mayor for signature.
services.where_to_apply: Office of the Municipal Mayor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Letter of Request stating the purpose
Valid Government-issued ID
Barangay Certification of Residency
Resume or CV (for employment)
procedure: Submit letter of request, valid ID, and barangay certification to the Mayor's Office.
Staff reviews and verifies the documents (5 min).
Staff prepares the recommendation letter for the Mayor's signature (5 min).
Receive the signed recommendation letter (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Get a recommendation letter from the Mayor for employment, scholarship, or other opportunities. Free service.

services.name: MDRRMO Document & Information Request
services.description: The Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) provides copies of documents and information related to disaster risk management, hazard maps, and emergency plans to requesting individuals or organizations.
services.description_full: The MDRRMO provides copies of documents and information related to disaster risk management upon request. This includes hazard maps, evacuation plans, disaster risk reduction plans, and other related documents. The client submits a letter of request, and the MDRRMO staff verifies availability and prepares the documents.
services.office: Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO)
services.where_to_apply: MDRRMO Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Letter of Request specifying the document or information needed
Valid Government-issued ID
procedure: Submit letter of request and valid ID to the MDRRMO Office.
Staff receives and reviews the request (2 min).
Staff verifies availability of the requested document or information (3 min).
If available, staff prepares and releases the document or information (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Request disaster risk management documents and information from the MDRRMO in Mapandan. Free service.

services.name: MDRRMO Training, Seminar & Workshop Request
services.description: The MDRRMO conducts training, seminars, and workshops on disaster preparedness, first aid, search and rescue, and other DRRM-related topics for barangays, schools, and organizations in Mapandan.
services.description_full: The MDRRMO conducts training, seminars, and workshops on disaster preparedness and risk reduction for barangay officials, community volunteers, students, and organizations. Topics include first aid, basic life support, search and rescue, fire suppression, and emergency response. The requesting entity submits a letter of request specifying the desired topic, schedule, and expected participants.
services.office: Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO)
services.where_to_apply: MDRRMO Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Letter of Request specifying topic, preferred schedule, and number of participants
Endorsement from the Barangay Captain (for barangay-level requests)
procedure: Submit letter of request and endorsement to the MDRRMO Office.
Staff receives and evaluates the request (3 min).
MDRRMO schedules the training, seminar, or workshop (coordination varies).
MDRRMO conducts the training at the agreed venue and schedule.
Participants receive certificates of completion (if applicable).
services.hero_lede: Request a disaster preparedness training or seminar from the MDRRMO in Mapandan. Free for barangays and organizations.

services.name: MDRRMO Rescue Operation & Emergency Medical Transport
services.description: The MDRRMO provides emergency rescue operations and medical transportation for residents of Mapandan during disasters, accidents, and medical emergencies. The service includes deployment of rescue teams and ambulance.
services.description_full: The MDRRMO provides 24/7 emergency rescue operations and medical transportation for residents of Mapandan. During disasters, accidents, and medical emergencies, the MDRRMO deploys its rescue teams and ambulance to respond to calls. The client or a family member contacts the MDRRMO hotline or reports in person. The MDRRMO assesses the situation, deploys the appropriate response team, and provides transportation to the nearest hospital if needed.
services.office: Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO)
services.processing_time: 30 minutes (response time varies by location and situation)
services.where_to_apply: MDRRMO Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: No prior requirements needed for emergency response — call or report directly
procedure: Call the MDRRMO hotline or report to the MDRRMO Office in case of emergency.
Provide details of the emergency: location, nature of incident, number of persons affected.
MDRRMO assesses the situation and deploys the rescue team and/or ambulance.
Rescue team provides first aid, rescue operations, or medical transportation as needed.
Patient or affected individuals are transported to the nearest hospital or safe location.
services.hero_lede: Emergency rescue and medical transport from the MDRRMO in Mapandan. Call the hotline for immediate assistance.

services.name: MDRRMO Standby / Transportation Request
services.description: The MDRRMO provides standby and transportation services for events, activities, and operations that require emergency preparedness and medical standby support.
services.description_full: The MDRRMO provides standby and transportation services for events, activities, and operations that require emergency preparedness and medical standby support. This includes deployment of ambulances and rescue vehicles for large gatherings, sports events, and other activities. The requesting entity submits a letter of request specifying the event details and expected requirements.
services.office: Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO)
services.where_to_apply: MDRRMO Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Letter of Request specifying event details, schedule, and venue
Event permit or endorsement from the Mayor's Office (if applicable)
procedure: Submit letter of request and event details to the MDRRMO Office.
Staff receives and evaluates the request (5 min).
MDRRMO coordinates the standby or transportation requirements (15 min).
MDRRMO deploys the ambulance and/or rescue vehicle to the event venue.
After the event, the MDRRMO unit stands down and returns to the station.
services.hero_lede: Request standby or transportation support from the MDRRMO for events and activities in Mapandan. Free service.

services.name: MDRRMO Walk-In Client Assistance
services.description: The MDRRMO provides walk-in assistance to residents who visit the office for disaster-related inquiries, complaints, coordination, and other concerns.
services.description_full: The MDRRMO provides walk-in assistance to residents who visit the office for disaster-related inquiries, complaints, coordination, and other concerns. The client is received by the duty officer, who assesses the concern and provides the appropriate assistance or referral. The MDRRMO also handles reports on flood damage, landslide, fire incidents, and other disaster-related events.
services.office: Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO)
services.where_to_apply: MDRRMO Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Valid Government-issued ID (for verification)
Any supporting documents related to the concern (if applicable)
procedure: Visit the MDRRMO Office and approach the duty officer.
Duty officer receives the client and assesses the concern (5 min).
Duty officer provides the appropriate assistance, information, or referral (5 min).
If the concern requires further action, the MDRRMO coordinates with the appropriate unit or agency (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Walk in to the MDRRMO Office for disaster-related inquiries, complaints, and coordination assistance. Free service.

services.name: Youth Organization Registration Program (YORP)
services.description: The Local Youth Development Office (LYDO) registers youth organizations in Mapandan under the Youth Organization Registration Program. Registration provides official recognition and access to LGU support, funding, and participation in youth programs.
services.description_full: The Local Youth Development Office (LYDO) administers the Youth Organization Registration Program (YORP) as mandated by the SK Reform Act (RA 11769). Registration provides official recognition of the youth organization, access to LGU support and funding opportunities, and participation in municipal, provincial, and national youth programs and activities. The LYDO assesses the application, verifies membership composition, and issues the Certificate of Registration.
services.where_to_apply: LYDO Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Letter of Intent to Register from the organization
Constitution and By-Laws of the organization
List of Officers and Members with ages (must be 15–30 years old)
Minutes of the organization's founding meeting
Endorsement from the Barangay Captain (if barangay-level organization)
procedure: Submit the letter of intent and all required documents to the LYDO Office.
LYDO staff receives and reviews the application (3 min).
LYDO verifies the membership composition and constitution (3 min).
LYDO prepares the Certificate of Registration (2 min).
Receive the Certificate of Registration upon approval (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Register your youth organization with the LYDO in Mapandan under the YORP. Free service, official recognition and program access.

services.name: Certified True Copy of Tax Declaration
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues certified true copies of Tax Declarations for real properties located in Mapandan. This document shows the assessed value of land, buildings, and improvements for taxation purposes.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues certified true copies of Tax Declarations upon request. The Tax Declaration is an official document showing the assessed value of real property for taxation purposes. The client submits a written request with the property details. The Assessor's Office locates the record, prepares the certified true copy, and releases it upon payment.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Written request stating the property location (lot number, block, street, barangay)
Valid Government-issued ID
procedure: Submit a written request with property details and valid ID to the Assessor's Office.
Staff receives and verifies the request (5 min).
Staff locates the Tax Declaration in the records (5 min).
Staff prepares the certified true copy and stamps it (3 min).
Pay ₱100 at the Treasury Office and claim the document (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Get a certified true copy of your Tax Declaration from the Assessor's Office. ₱100, 15 minutes processing.

services.name: No Improvement / With Improvement Certificate
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues a certificate indicating whether a property has declared improvements (buildings, structures, or other constructions). This is required for various transactions including property sale and loan applications.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues a certificate indicating whether a real property has declared improvements such as buildings, structures, or other constructions on the land. This certificate is required for property transactions, loan applications, and other legal purposes. The fee depends on the assessed value of the property.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Written request stating the property location
Valid Government-issued ID
procedure: Submit a written request with property details and valid ID to the Assessor's Office.
Staff receives and verifies the request (5 min).
Staff checks the property record for declared improvements (5 min).
Staff prepares and issues the certificate (3 min).
Pay the required fee at the Treasury Office and claim the certificate (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Get a No Improvement or With Improvement Certificate from the Assessor's Office. Fees ₱100–₱600 based on assessed value.

services.name: Landholdings Certificate
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues a Landholdings Certificate showing all real properties registered under a person's name within the municipality. This is required for tax compliance verification and legal transactions.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues a Landholdings Certificate showing all real properties registered under a person's name within the Municipality of Mapandan. This certificate is used for tax compliance verification, legal transactions, and property portfolio documentation. The client submits a written request, and the Assessor's Office compiles the information from the property records.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Written request stating the name of the property owner
Valid Government-issued ID
procedure: Submit a written request with the property owner's name and valid ID to the Assessor's Office.
Staff receives and verifies the request (5 min).
Staff searches the records for all properties under the name (5 min).
Staff compiles and prepares the Landholdings Certificate (3 min).
Pay ₱100 at the Treasury Office and claim the certificate (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Get a Landholdings Certificate showing all your registered properties in Mapandan. ₱100, 15 minutes processing.

services.name: Declaring Undeclared Properties
services.description: Property owners who have not declared their real property for taxation may voluntarily declare it with the Municipal Assessor's Office. The Assessor appraises the property and issues a new Tax Declaration.
services.description_full: Property owners who have not declared their real property for taxation purposes may voluntarily declare it with the Municipal Assessor's Office. The Assessor appraises the land and any improvements, and issues a new Tax Declaration. This process brings the property into the tax rolls and avoids penalties for non-declaration. The fee covers the appraisal and declaration process.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Valid Government-issued ID of the property owner
Proof of ownership (Deed of Sale, Deed of Donation, Tax-Exempt Certificate, or Inheritance documents)
Blueprints or sketches of the property (if available)
Barangay Certification of ownership
procedure: Visit the Assessor's Office and submit all required documents.
Staff receives and reviews the application (5 min).
Assessor conducts appraisal of the land and improvements (15 min).
Staff prepares the Tax Declaration (5 min).
Pay ₱700 at the Treasury Office and claim the Tax Declaration (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Declare an undeclared property with the Assessor's Office. ₱700 appraisal fee, 30 minutes processing.

services.name: Declaring Unrevised / Missing Tax Declaration
services.description: Property owners whose Tax Declaration has been lost, destroyed, or never issued may apply for a replacement or new declaration with the Municipal Assessor's Office.
services.description_full: Property owners whose Tax Declaration has been lost, destroyed, or was never issued may apply for a replacement or new declaration with the Municipal Assessor's Office. The Assessor verifies the property records, conducts appraisal if needed, and issues a new Tax Declaration. This ensures the property remains in the tax rolls with accurate records.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Affidavit of Loss (if Tax Declaration was lost or destroyed)
Valid Government-issued ID
Proof of ownership (Deed of Sale, Tax receipts, or other documents)
Blueprints or sketches of the property (if available)
procedure: Visit the Assessor's Office and submit all required documents.
Staff receives and verifies the application (5 min).
Assessor checks records and conducts appraisal if needed (15 min).
Staff prepares the new Tax Declaration (5 min).
Pay ₱700 at the Treasury Office and claim the Tax Declaration (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Replace a lost or missing Tax Declaration at the Assessor's Office. ₱700 fee, 30 minutes processing.

services.name: Appraisal for Newly Declared Titled Property
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office conducts appraisal of newly declared titled real property for tax assessment purposes. The assessed value is used as basis for real property tax computation.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office conducts appraisal of newly declared titled real property to determine its assessed value for taxation purposes. The appraisal covers the land area, market value, and any improvements. The assessed value becomes the basis for computing real property taxes. The process includes review of the title, site inspection, and computation of assessed value.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Transfer Certificate of Title (TCT) or Condominium Certificate of Title (CCT)
Valid Government-issued ID of the owner
Deed of Sale or other proof of acquisition
Blueprints or sketches of improvements (if any)
procedure: Submit all required documents to the Assessor's Office.
Staff receives and reviews the application (5 min).
Assessor reviews the title and conducts site inspection if needed (15 min).
Staff computes the assessed value and prepares the Tax Declaration (5 min).
Pay ₱700 at the Treasury Office and claim the Tax Declaration (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Get your newly titled property appraised by the Assessor's Office. ₱700 fee, 30 minutes processing.

services.name: Appraisal for Newly Declared Untitled Property
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office conducts appraisal of newly declared untitled real property for tax assessment purposes. This covers properties without a registered title but with proof of ownership.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office conducts appraisal of newly declared untitled real property to determine its assessed value for taxation purposes. Untitled properties are appraised based on the land area, market value, location, and any improvements. The assessed value becomes the basis for computing real property taxes. The process includes verification of ownership documents, site inspection, and computation of assessed value.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Valid Government-issued ID of the owner
Proof of ownership (Deed of Sale, Deed of Donation, Tax-Exempt Certificate, or Inheritance documents)
Blueprints or sketches of the property (if available)
Barangay Certification of ownership
procedure: Submit all required documents to the Assessor's Office.
Staff receives and reviews the application (5 min).
Assessor conducts site inspection and appraisal (15 min).
Staff computes the assessed value and prepares the Tax Declaration (5 min).
Pay ₱700 at the Treasury Office and claim the Tax Declaration (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Get your untitled property appraised by the Assessor's Office. ₱700 fee, 30 minutes processing.

services.name: Building Appraisal / Assessment
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office conducts appraisal and assessment of buildings and other structures for real property taxation. This includes new construction, renovation, and re-appraisal of existing buildings.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office conducts appraisal and assessment of buildings and other structures for real property taxation purposes. The assessment covers the type of construction, floor area, materials used, depreciation, and current market value. The assessed value of the building is added to the land's assessed value for real property tax computation. The process includes review of building plans, site inspection, and computation of assessed value.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Building plans or blueprints
Certificate of Occupancy (from MEO)
Valid Government-issued ID of the owner
Tax Declaration of the land
procedure: Submit all required documents to the Assessor's Office.
Staff receives and reviews the application (5 min).
Assessor conducts site inspection of the building (15 min).
Staff computes the assessed value and prepares the updated Tax Declaration (5 min).
Pay ₱700 at the Treasury Office and claim the updated Tax Declaration (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Get your building appraised and assessed by the Assessor's Office. ₱700 fee, 30 minutes processing.

services.name: Land Reclassification / Reassessment
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office conducts reclassification or reassessment of land when there is a change in land use, classification, or other factors affecting the property's assessed value.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office conducts reclassification or reassessment of land when there is a change in land use, zoning classification, or other factors affecting the property's assessed value. This may be triggered by rezoning, subdivision, conversion from agricultural to residential or commercial use, or other changes. The Assessor reviews the applicable ordinances, conducts inspection, and updates the Tax Declaration accordingly.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Written request stating the reason for reclassification/reassessment
Valid Government-issued ID
Zoning clearance or land use change approval (from MPDC)
Current Tax Declaration
procedure: Submit written request, valid ID, and supporting documents to the Assessor's Office.
Staff receives and reviews the application (5 min).
Assessor reviews zoning/land use changes and conducts inspection (15 min).
Staff updates the Tax Declaration with the new classification and assessed value (5 min).
Pay ₱700 at the Treasury Office and claim the updated Tax Declaration (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Reclassify or reassess your land at the Assessor's Office. ₱700 fee, 30 minutes processing.

services.name: Tax Map Issuance
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues tax maps showing the location, boundaries, and lot details of real properties for taxation and legal purposes.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues tax maps showing the location, boundaries, dimensions, and lot details of real properties within Mapandan. Tax maps are required for property transactions, land use planning, and other legal purposes. The client submits a written request with the lot details, and the Assessor's Office prepares the tax map from their records.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Written request specifying the lot number, block, street, and barangay
Valid Government-issued ID
procedure: Submit a written request with lot details and valid ID to the Assessor's Office.
Staff receives and verifies the request (3 min).
Staff locates the tax map in the records (7 min).
Staff prepares and issues the tax map (3 min).
Pay ₱100 at the Treasury Office and claim the tax map (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Get a tax map from the Assessor's Office showing your property's location and boundaries. ₱100, 15 minutes.

services.name: Inquiries & Verifications
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office provides information and verification services regarding real property records, assessed values, tax declarations, and other property-related inquiries.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office provides information and verification services regarding real property records, assessed values, tax declarations, and other property-related inquiries. The client may inquire about the status of their property, verify assessed values, check for outstanding obligations, or request general information about property taxation. The Assessor's Office staff provides the information from their records.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Valid Government-issued ID
Property details (lot number, block, street, barangay) if inquiring about a specific property
procedure: Visit the Assessor's Office and present your valid ID.
State your inquiry or verification request to the staff.
Staff looks up the information in the records (10 min).
Staff provides the information or prints the verification document (3 min).
Pay ₱100 at the Treasury Office if a printed document is required (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Inquire or verify real property records at the Assessor's Office. ₱100 for printed verification, 15 minutes.

services.name: Other Assessor Certificates
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues various other certificates related to real property, including clearance certificates, non-declaration certificates, and other property-related certifications.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office issues various certificates related to real property beyond the standard Tax Declaration copies. Property details (lot number, block, street, barangay)

Staff receives and reviews the request (3 min).
Staff verifies the information in the records (7 min).
Staff prepares and issues the certificate (3 min).
Pay ₱100 at the Treasury Office and claim the certificate (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Get various property-related certificates from the Assessor's Office. ₱100 per certificate, 15 minutes.

services.name: Recording & Cancellation of Annotations
services.description: The Municipal Assessor's Office records new annotations (such as mortgages, liens, and court orders) or cancels existing annotations on Tax Declarations. This ensures accurate property records for legal and financial transactions.
services.description_full: The Municipal Assessor's Office records new annotations or cancels existing annotations on Tax Declarations. Annotations include mortgages, liens, legal inhibitions, court orders, and other encumbrances affecting the property. The client submits the supporting documents (e.g., Deed of Mortgage, Release of Mortgage, Court Order), and the Assessor's Office updates the Tax Declaration accordingly.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Deed of Mortgage / Release of Mortgage (for mortgage annotations)
Court Order or Writ of Attachment (for legal annotations)
Valid Government-issued ID of the property owner
Current Tax Declaration
procedure: Submit the supporting documents and valid ID to the Assessor's Office.

Staff verifies the authenticity and completeness of the documents (5 min).
Staff records the annotation or cancellation on the Tax Declaration (5 min).
Pay ₱150 at the Treasury Office and claim the updated Tax Declaration (5 min).
services.hero_lede: Record or cancel annotations on your Tax Declaration at the Assessor's Office. ₱150, 20 minutes processing.

services.name: Environmental Complaints Processing
services.description: The Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office (MENRO) receives and processes complaints related to environmental violations, pollution, illegal dumping, and other environmental concerns in Mapandan.
services.description_full: The Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office (MENRO) receives and processes complaints related to environmental violations, pollution, illegal dumping, and other environmental concerns in Mapandan. services.office: Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office (MENRO)

Evidence of violation (photos, videos, or other documentation if available)

procedure: Submit the written complaint with evidence and valid ID to the MENRO Office.
MENRO staff receives and evaluates the complaint (5 min).
MENRO verifies the complaint through site inspection or investigation (varies).
MENRO takes appropriate enforcement action and coordinates with concerned agencies.
Follow up with MENRO for the status of the complaint.
services.hero_lede: File an environmental complaint with the MENRO in Mapandan. Report pollution, illegal dumping, and other violations. Free service.

services.name: Pre-Marriage Orientation & Counseling (Population Office)
services.description: The Population Office provides pre-marriage orientation and counseling to couples planning to get married. The session covers family planning, reproductive health, and responsible parenthood. A certificate is issued upon completion.
services.description_full: The Population Office provides pre-marriage orientation and counseling to couples planning to get married as required before obtaining a marriage license. The session covers family planning methods, reproductive health, responsible parenthood, and RA 9255. A Certificate of Pre-Marriage Counseling is issued upon completion, which is a prerequisite for marriage license application.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Population Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Valid Government-issued ID of both parties
Community Tax Certificate (Cedula) from Treasury Office
procedure: Visit the Population Office with your partner and present valid IDs.
Staff records the couple's information and schedules the session.
Attend the pre-marriage orientation and counseling session.
Receive the Certificate of Pre-Marriage Counseling upon completion.
services.hero_lede: Complete your pre-marriage counseling at the Population Office in Mapandan. Free session, certificate issued upon completion.

services.name: LGU PhilHealth Group Enrollment
services.description: The Population Office facilitates group enrollment of indigent residents to PhilHealth under the LGU-sponsored program. Enrolled members receive health insurance coverage for hospitalization and medical services.
services.description_full: The Population Office facilitates group enrollment of indigent residents to PhilHealth under the Local Government Unit (LGU)-sponsored program. The LGU subsidizes the premium contributions of qualified beneficiaries. Enrolled members receive health insurance coverage for hospitalization and medical services at PhilHealth-accredited facilities. The Population Office verifies eligibility, collects required documents, and submits the enrollment to PhilHealth.
services.processing_time: 10 minutes (processing); enrollment effective upon PhilHealth validation
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Population Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Valid Government-issued ID
Certificate of Indigency from the Barangay Captain
Birth Certificate or any valid ID showing date of birth
procedure: Visit the Population Office and submit the required documents.
Staff verifies eligibility and reviews the documents (3 min).
Staff fills out the PhilHealth enrollment form (3 min).
Staff submits the enrollment to PhilHealth for validation (2 min).
Receive confirmation of enrollment. PhilHealth ID will be distributed upon availability (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Enroll in the LGU-sponsored PhilHealth program at the Population Office. Free health insurance for indigent residents.
